description: Valid PH-01 phase with four stories, each mapping FR/AC, dependencies, testability and evidence. Must validate against phase-story.schema.json.

phase.name: 最小治理纵向切片
phase.goal: Form a script-verifiable loop from Requirement Anchor to CompletionEvaluator without live Agents.
exitCriteria: later phases can extend same contract
phase.runtimeBoundary: contract, schema, fixture, validator and dry-run interface only

stories.title: 冻结控制权与所有权
stories.goal: Freeze Codex authority order, internal profiles and independent Skill boundaries.
stories.testability: validator rejects ownership conflicts and missing authority entries

stories.title: 建立 Requirement Anchor 与 Artifact 谱系
stories.goal: Make goal, scope, FR/AC, artifact versions and owners traceable.
stories.testability: schema validation of anchor and artifact envelope

stories.title: 定义软件公司角色与 SOP 契约
stories.goal: Define five business roles, SOP stages, artifacts and ownership boundaries.

stories.title: 建立 Phase/Story 需求契约
stories.goal: Let complex goals decompose into testable stories mapped to FR/AC.
stories.testability: phase-story.schema.json rejects missing fields and cycles
